snippet.title: VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS: Bakunawa Killer Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
"Who is that guy?"
The so-called "Bakunawa Killer" has been tied to a series of violent attacks throughout Vilasapara.
It seems Pai Chan has been searching for him, but why...

---------------------------------
A city you've never seen
A story you've never heard
A totally new Virtua Fighter

Experience a rich, cinematic single-player adventure with immersive narrative-driven gameplay, and the series’ trademark thrilling VS battles!

This isn’t a remake. This isn't a trip down memory lane.
This is the next evolution of VIRTUA FIGHTER.
